$comment: Tracker §0.12 requires that the ABI mapping of the compact on-chain form be documented.
This file IS that documentation in machine-readable form, transcribed by hand from the
REASON_* constants in contracts/src/TinjauRiskTypes.sol. It is not imported from Tinjau's
code; a stranger with this file can expand a bitmask without running any Tinjau software.
Bit positions are permanent. A retired reason stops being set; its position is never
reused, or historical records become unreadable.
Positions 15, 22, 23, 29, 30 and 31 are UNDEFINED in schema tinjau.risk/1.0.0. A record
carrying one of them was written by a newer schema than this reader understands. The
reader REFUSES such a record instead of masking the bit off: silently dropping a newer
writer's bit would make the record read as though that fact never existed.

bits.meaning: Evidence is rumour-only (social or unattributed). Hard cap at WATCH; no market argument can lift it.
Only one genuinely independent origin was found. One source alone never authorises the aggressive path.
Several outlets carried the story, but they trace to one origin, so they count as one source.
Sources conflict on a material field.
The evidence fell outside its recency window.
No official filing confirms the claim.
The token is known, but it has no verified pool in the supported set.
The company is known, but which of its tokens the claim concerns was not resolved.
The independent market check corroborated the event within the freshness bound.
The market was checked and did not corroborate the event.
Market data existed but was older than the freshness bound.
The market could not be checked at all (no data, RPC failure, pool untraded).
The price move was a single short-lived spike, not a sustained move.
Executable exit depth in the pool was too thin to conclude anything.
The US reference market was closed during the observation window.
An issuer or regulator filing is present in the evidence set.
At least two genuinely independent origins were found.
The bonded parse-agreement path passed for the official document.
The filing is real but reports no corporate action affecting obligations, solvency, or listing status. Official does not mean material.
The company itself has never been seen before. Distinct from AMBIGUOUS_ENTITY and UNSUPPORTED_ASSET.
Market data was present but too sparse to conclude anything. Distinct from MARKET_DATA_UNAVAILABLE, which means the check could not run.

The anti-wick hold interval was unreachable or too sparse to judge, so persistence was never observed either way. Distinct from ANTI_WICK_FAILED, which is a positive finding that the move was watched and retraced.
The assessment passed its expiry.
The bounded fee finished its deterministic decay back to the base fee.
A new protection cannot re-arm yet; the cooldown after the last one has not elapsed.
New protections were blocked by the guardian's pause at assessment time.
The bounded on-chain action was attempted and failed. Recorded without claiming any protection benefit.

RiskState.name: NORMAL
RiskState.meaning: No material unresolved evidence. Baseline fee only. Also what an unwritten record reads as.

RiskState.name: WATCH
RiskState.meaning: Monitoring raised. The aggressive fee is NOT authorised.

RiskState.name: PROTECT
RiskState.meaning: A bounded, time-limited fee action is authorised.

ConfidenceBand.name: UNKNOWN
ConfidenceBand.meaning: Never written. Cannot be posted; reading it means no record exists.

ConfidenceBand.name: LOW
ConfidenceBand.meaning: Low confidence. Reaches at most one third of the way up the fee band.

ConfidenceBand.name: MEDIUM
ConfidenceBand.meaning: Medium confidence. Reaches at most two thirds of the way up the fee band.

ConfidenceBand.name: HIGH
ConfidenceBand.meaning: High confidence. May reach the top of the fee band.

DataMode.name: OBSERVED
DataMode.meaning: Observed, though not necessarily in real time.

DataMode.name: REPLAY
DataMode.meaning: Historical data replayed from an immutable fixture. Not live discovery.

DataMode.name: SIMULATED
DataMode.meaning: Fabricated for testing. NOT evidence of anything real.

ConfirmationStatus.name: NOT_CONFIRMED
ConfirmationStatus.meaning: Checked; the market did not corroborate.

ConfirmationStatus.name: UNAVAILABLE
ConfirmationStatus.meaning: Could not check. 'We could not look' is a different finding from 'we looked and saw nothing'.

ConfirmationStatus.name: STALE
ConfirmationStatus.meaning: Data existed but was older than the freshness bound.

ConfirmationStatus.name: CONFIRMED
ConfirmationStatus.meaning: Checked and corroborated within the freshness bound. The only value that satisfies a PROTECT gate.
